clip-to-base (MaskFormat::BaseAlpha): supports_clip_to_base() = true; run [base, c1..cn] (base = nearest earlier unclipped layer of the group) evaluated per chunk into one scratch buffer G = base content with its own mask (no opacity/fill/mode); each ci composited onto G with own mode/opacity/fill and source alpha * base alpha, G alpha held at base alpha (read from G itself, no extra plane); G composited onto the running backdrop with the BASE layer's mode/opacity/fill; group extent ignores clipped layers (never beyond base); isolated and pass-through parent groups work (pass-through parent: run lands on the running backdrop); per-pixel, so chunk and thread determinism is unchanged; scratch need = 1 level per run + deepest member (accounted in need/peak_working_bytes); isolated-group base evaluates straight into G; exactness Approximate (Photoshop rule UNVERIFIED)

report(): one Observe terminal frame; example render-cpu-consumer; DESCRIPTOR updated (clip_to_base key, clip_base_pass_through unsupported, clipping removed from pending) and still checked against constants

R3 (SMB-RENDER-CPU CONFIRMED x2): (1) pass-through layer with fill_opacity < 1 refused in prepare as Unsupported{group_pass_through_fill_opacity} before the first sink call (a non-isolated group has no group result to scale; opacity < 1 was already refused); (2) a panic in a worker or in TileSink::accept is caught (workers: whole loop under catch_unwind -> Message::Failed; sink: deliver() on every thread count) and returned as Unavailable(worker_panic|sink_panic); StopWorkers releases parked workers on any exit incl. unwind; the parallel path can no longer hang

ADJ-1 (49afca1): RenderBackend::extension_exactness (AdjustmentLayer, Adjustment(_), BlendIf, MaskDensity, MaskFeather = Exact so the receipt class is pigment's intrinsic Approximate; Knockout and unknown operators Unsupported) and execute_extended (Renderer::execute_extended_detailed): admit_extended first, ExtPrep::build (adjustments prepared once, identical feather radii share a kernel, resident tables charged as a running aggregate to max_working_bytes before allocation), then the existing chunked compositor. Adjustment layer: per pixel of the placeholder rect k = opacity*fill*mask*blend_if and adjust_math::composite_adjustment on the group running buffer (inside a clip run on the run buffer G only); Blend-If: coverage_math::blend_if_weight multiplies the source alpha (also the clip-run composite with the base layer's ranges; the source colour of an adjustment layer is its content f(backdrop), Studio rule); mask density/invert via coverage_math::mask_coverage (density 1 keeps the v1 inversion so v1 bytes are unchanged); mask feather: per-chunk separable blur with coverage_math::feather_kernel, feather_support margin, clamped at the mask plane border, before invert/density; per-worker feather scratch (chunk plane + horizontal pass with margin rows) is part of the reserved scratch (peak_working_bytes). Empty envelope without a density mask takes the v1 path (bytes and receipt identical); a density mask with an empty envelope takes the envelope admission (mask_density Approximate). V4-01: plan_sink.rs, plan_sink/extended.rs, px.rs deny clippy::arithmetic_side_effects.

FX2 (8d46aa8, SMB-RENDER-CPU-FX2): wave 2 effect kinds inner shadow, outer glow and inner glow enabled through the windowed path (no kind-specific code); extension_exactness reports ExtOperator::intrinsic() (Approximate) for all six kinds; gradient glow, Precise technique, range below 100 % and jitter remain typed refusals by feature key at pigment admission before the first sink call; bit-identical to render_layer_reference (mixed six-effect stack, chunks 48/17/7/5 on 1-3 workers) and to the uncut windowed oracle (304 px margin); budget charged by the same frame_shape and layer_window_cost model, limit-1 refused with 0 sink calls (tests/cpu_effects_fx2.rs, 3 tests).

WINDOW (be1836b, SMB-RENDER-CPU-WINDOW): effects wave 1 run on pigment effect_math::window (a797b67/379a56f): per chunk the effect window W = layer bounds grown by stack_support_px (the stack margin), clipped to the chunk; WindowGeometry::uncut(bounds, margin, W) with site_origin (0, 0); AlphaSource FrameAlpha over a content frame (frame_content: tile/solid/vector/isolated group times the mask with feather, density, invert; frame = W grown by the margin clipped to the layer bounds, so memory follows min(layer, chunk + 2 * margin)^2 and not a 64 px plane); render_layer_window composes the window over the running backdrop; the 24 px effect_margin refusal and the per-tile 64 x 64 recompute are gone, any margin renders. Budget: the per-worker frame (16 B per pixel per group level), frame feather scratch, window input arrays (28 B per window pixel) and pigment layer_window_cost peak of the largest window are part of the reserved scratch / peak_working_bytes and charged to max_working_bytes before the first sink call; the predicted peak is also WindowLimits.max_bytes, WindowLimits.max_work = MAX_EFFECT_WINDOW_WORK (1e9, new pub const); a layer whose largest window is predicted above it is Unsupported{effect_work_limit} before the first sink call. extension_exactness unchanged (pigment's intrinsic class). V4-01: effects.rs / extended.rs keep deny(arithmetic_side_effects).

EFFECTS-1 (c4bdaef, 5674e9c): layer effects wave 1 through execute_extended with pigment effect_math as the single owner (render_layer_reference: matte maths, composition order, fade rules). A layer with effects is evaluated per tile of a frame (tile + effect_support_px margin, <= 64 px per side = pigment's reference plane; tile side min(64 - 2*margin, chunk side)): content over the frame by the chunked compositor (nested isolated group, mask with feather/density/invert read clamped beyond the plane), EffectPlane, render_layer_reference over the running backdrop of the tile, tile written back. Layer bounds and group extent grow by the margin. extension_exactness: Effect(DropShadow|ColourOverlay|Stroke) Exact (receipt class Approximate); other EffectKind (pigment d982b5c inner shadow / outer glow / inner glow) Unsupported. Typed refusals before the first sink call: margin > 24 px (effect_margin), effects with Blend-If on one layer (effects_with_blend_if), effects inside the content of a layer with effects (effects_nested). Per-worker frame memory (content frame, group levels, 3 reference planes, mattes, frame feather scratch) is part of the reserved scratch / peak_working_bytes; effect records charged as a running aggregate. decisions_for_lead: Dissolve (and any stochastic mode) in effects now uses plan coordinates with seed 0 (WindowGeometry site_origin (0, 0)), equal to render_layer_reference on a plane placed at the plan origin and independent of chunking; the previous per-tile reference used frame-relative coordinates, which depended on the chunk size. The v1 compositor keeps absolute coordinates with seed = plan revision (unchanged), so a dissolve effect and a dissolve layer use different seeds.

One window per chunk and effect layer, no sub-tiling; MAX_EFFECT_WINDOW_WORK = 1e9 inner-loop visits (about seconds) bounds the time between cancel/deadline checks; a larger window is a typed refusal at admission and the chunk size is the knob (a 1000 px blur with 8 px chunks is admitted, with 512 px chunks refused). Lead may change the constant.

The alpha source reads a content frame (layer content clipped to window + margin) instead of evaluating the layer per read: the content is evaluated once per chunk window, i.e. ((chunk + 2 * margin) / chunk)^2 times per pixel for large margins (pigment recomputes its halo per window the same way); a larger chunk size reduces it. Memory is charged, not hidden.

Effect kinds beyond wave 1 (inner shadow, outer glow, inner glow) stay Unsupported in extension_exactness although the windowed API evaluates them; enabling them is a separate lane with its own tests.
plausible_not_addressed: cancel and deadline are still observed between chunks only; a window is bounded by MAX_EFFECT_WINDOW_WORK, not interruptible.
per-worker frame buffers are allocated eagerly at the worst-case size (charged), not lazily.
pigment dilation is O(window area x offsets): a large spread is refused through the work limit, not approximated.

layer_window_cost is evaluated once for the largest window of each layer; smaller edge windows rely on pigment's own limit check (WindowLimits bytes = the largest predicted peak) which returns a typed BudgetExceeded if a prediction were ever not monotone.

decisions_for_lead: Pigment's reference reads zero beyond its plane (shift_zero, blur, dilate), so render_layer_reference equals the backend only when the plane holds the layer plus its margin; the backend evaluates frames beyond the target and yields the uncut shadow (first stack attempt: 21 px off by 8e-7 .. 3e-4 near the plane edge because the test plane was smaller; the test plane was fixed, not the backend).

Effects together with Blend-If on one layer are refused (effects_with_blend_if): the Blend-If weight depends on the backdrop of the content composite and Photoshop behaviour with effects is UNVERIFIED; pigment admits the combination, so this is a backend-side refusal that happens after shared admission (still before the first sink call).
Effects nested inside the content of an effect layer are refused (effects_nested), same reason: one frame scratch per worker.

Mask on an effect layer multiplies the content alpha (the shape alpha the matte is derived from, pigment module doc); without effects the v1 path multiplies the mask into opacity, so a masked effect layer can differ from the same layer without effects by f32 rounding.
Effect kinds pigment added after wave 1 (d982b5c inner shadow, outer glow, inner glow) are Unsupported here until implemented and tested (kind-by-kind allow list in extension_exactness).
api_changes_needed_in_pigment: Windowed matte API: effect_math::reference_matte / render_layer_reference work on planes of at most 64 x 64 and recompute the margin of every tile, so this backend refuses effect margins above 24 px (effect_margin) and a layer pays (64 / tile side)^2 recompute. A production path needs a matte function over a window with an explicit halo contract (window rect + halo from effect_support_px, no 64 px plane limit, work budget per window) and a streaming dilate/blur; then margins up to MAX_EFFECT_SIZE_PX (1000) become possible.
plausible_not_addressed: EffectPlane / render_layer_reference allocate inside pigment per tile (several 16 KB-class vectors); the scratch charge is an estimate of those allocations (4 bytes per pixel x (effects + 12) + 3 planes of 16 bytes), not a measured bound.

Pixels of an effect region where nothing is drawn are rewritten with the reference's composite_over(a_s = 0) result, which equals the backdrop for opaque backdrops and can differ by an ulp for translucent ones.
Effect compute cost per tile is not charged to a deadline-aware budget; cancel and deadline are observed between chunks only.
